name: Faughart

attributes.attribute: a small town in County Louth

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Faughart is an Irish mythological site. The small town sits in County Louth. It is known as the birthplace of Saint Brigit. Brigit is a Christianized form who shared the name of the Celtic goddess. A holy well at the site carries a reputation for healing eye diseases.

okr.objective: Faughart is a County Louth town tied to Saint Brigit.
key_results: It is the reputed birthplace of Saint Brigit.
Brigit is a Christianized form of the Celtic goddess.
A holy well there heals eye complaints.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
